maddeler.e:
نستبشر (form X)
# نَسْتَبْشِرُ (nastabširu) /nas.tab.ʃi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبْشَرَ (istabšara)
# نَسْتَبْشِرَ (nastabšira) /nas.tab.ʃi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبْشَرَ (istabšara)
# نَسْتَبْشِرْ (nastabšir) /nas.tab.ʃir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَبْشَرَ (istabšara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
